notes: Job Agent 3.1.0 Beta introduces privacy-safe Fit Intelligence diagnostics for the full scored vacancy pool: APPLY/REVIEW/SKIP totals per Data/BI, Support and QA, a primary and contributing blocker analysis, searchable-run funnel counts, and an aggregate last-run summary in Dashboard with detailed tooltips. A local atomic fit_report.json holds aggregate counts only, never personal data or job details. Includes the previously merged 3.0.16 cross-site Alma numeric-ID deduplication. No score thresholds, browser budgets, application safeguards, CV routing or manual-final-submit behavior changed. New pure-Python and real Qt offscreen regression coverage; PR and main GitHub Actions tests succeeded. After installing, run a new search to populate the diagnostic summary.
